label: Local value numbering
subgoals: Give every input and every new result a value number
Key each operation by its operator and operand numbers
Replace an operation whose key already exists with a copy

label: Commutativity and canonical keys
subgoals: Sort the operands of commutative operators before forming the key
Keep operand order for non-commutative operators
Recognize that value numbering sees only syntactic equality

label: Redefinition kills availability
subgoals: Update a variable's value number on every reassignment
Stop matching expressions whose operands were redefined
Count each replaced operation as one cell saved
